*PhD Candidate · Environmental Microbiology · Online Flow Cytometry · Machine Learning*

[Email](mailto:isabel_katharina.erb@ple.lth.se) · [GitHub](https://github.com/isabel-erb) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-5161-2336) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=z3tJCY8AAAAJ&hl=de&oi=ao)


## Profile

I am a final-year industrial PhD candidate in Biotechnology and Applied Microbiology at Lund University and Sweden Water Research. My research combines microbial water quality monitoring, online flow cytometry, environmental data, and machine learning.

I am particularly interested in developing interpretable data-driven approaches for understanding and predicting changes in microbial water quality.

## Research Experience

### Doctoral Student
**Lund University & Sweden Water Research AB**  
*2022–present*

Research on data-driven microbial water-quality monitoring using online flow cytometry, automated *E. coli* measurements, environmental monitoring, machine learning, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and explainable AI.

### Visiting Doctoral Researcher
**Veitur · Reykjavík, Iceland**  
*March–May 2025*

Investigated microbial dynamics in groundwater used for drinking-water production using online flow cytometry, unsupervised machine learning, operational data, meteorological data, and explainable AI.

### Research Assistant
**Sweden Water Research · Lund, Sweden**  
*June–October 2022*

Established continuous microbial monitoring of seawater using BactoSense online flow cytometry and ColiMinder automated *E. coli* monitoring.

### Master's Thesis
**Lund University · Sweden**  
*January–June 2022*

Genomic and phenotypic characterization of environmental *E. coli* isolated from urban marine sediments.
